title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement
tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

faults.what: The detailed shop interior and large dark headline panel make the background busier than the requested clean cream backdrop.

judge.summary: A polished square post with abundant lush plants and the correct readable headline, though the busy interior departs from the clean cream background requested.

must_haves.item: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
must_haves.why: The exact wording appears across two lines.

must_haves.item: Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
must_haves.why: Numerous lush potted plants are visible throughout a room with cream walls, although shelves and windows make the backdrop busy.

must_haves.item: The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.
must_haves.why: Large white lettering contrasts clearly with the dark panel and is fully within the image.
No text other than the requested headline is visible.
